metadata.title: कैंसर से जंग - जीना गायों के संग | From Cancer Survivor to Dairy Entrepreneur | Inspiring Story
metadata.description:
This is the powerful story of Seema Singh, a woman from a small village in Jharkhand who turned pain into purpose.
After battling and defeating cancer, Seema Singh rebuilt her life from the ground up. With courage, determination, and unwavering resolve, she chose cow rearing (dairy farming) as a path to self-reliance. What began as a struggle for survival soon became a journey of success.
Today, Seema Singh is a successful rural entrepreneur, earning enough to invest lakhs of rupees in her children’s education—a dream that once seemed impossible. Her story is not just about livelihood, but about dignity, resilience, and the power of hard work.
This video captures a journey filled with pain, grit, hope, and achievement, showing how one woman transformed her life and became an inspiration for countless others in rural India.
📍 Location: Jharkhand
🐄 Livelihood: Dairy Farming
💪 Theme: Women Empowerment | Rural Entrepreneurship | Cancer Survivor Story
